categories.question: Which tide-pool creature belongs on your seaside postcard?

outcomes.name: Bat star
outcomes.description: Orange-red bat star with very broad webbed triangular arms and a flattened pentagonal outline

outcomes.name: Acorn barnacle
outcomes.description: Cluster of pale volcano-shaped barnacles attached to a tiny pebble

outcomes.name: Sea lemon
outcomes.description: Golden-yellow oval nudibranch with a bumpy mantle, paired rhinophores and gill plume

outcomes.name: Black turban snail
outcomes.description: Dark heavy spiral shell, pearly worn patch and a black grazing foot
